evidence: [M] prints that along the single stable sequence of Proposition 16.x (prop:SC), for every fixed d,a,K, both r_k(U^{d+1})^{-1} d_a U^d -> d_a^Max and (U^d)^{-1} L_d(K) U^d -> L_d^Max(K) in operator norm. In [L], A04/A05 are `Watches` statements: the derivative limit (ConLap) and the raw charge limit `(X.xi i)⁻¹ • transport Y (X.U i d) j -> κ • leaf K.lie d j` hold for any scaling X satisfying `Track X V T J H a n d k B` beyond thresholds depending on d, and the normalized rotation limit for c⁻¹•Y is only produced in Commission.lens (`∀ d, ∃ U w, Spin.Tilt ... (c⁻¹ • I.Y) d U w`), which `station`'s private `services` proves by a fresh `selects` of a scaling Q for each d and uses c/Q.xi -> κ derived on that Q. No declaration states both limits along one fixed stable X (YM.Next.UVStress.Stable) for all d; getting that would need focused_track tails plus the currencies argument re-run on X, which [L] does not write, so the claim stands and it is not a typo.

[M] prints: along the single stable sequence of Prop SC, for every fixed d,a,K, both r_k(F_{d+1})^{-1} d_a F_d -> d_a^Max and F_d^{-1} L_d(K) F_d -> L_d^Max(K) in operator norm. [L]'s A04 gives only the derivative limit (ConLap), and only as Watches: for some thresholds (D,N,m,R), every Scaling X admitting a Track with d>=D satisfies it, i.e. per scaling and per d, not one sequence for all d. The rotation limit appears only through Spin.Tilt (Commission.lens: 'forall d, exists U w, Tilt ...'), where the transports U are chosen separately for each d and are not the scale frames; ActLaw.connects likewise supplies a different X for each (N,d,m,R). No declaration states the single sequence with both limits for all d,a,K, so the claim stands.
